title: CE60124: Turbulent Fluid Flow
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Statistical structures of turbulence; two-dimensional flow structures and
effect of roughness; measurements of turbulence; three-dimensional flow
structures driven by turbulence; secondary currents; diffusion and dispersion;
turbulence model calculations; Coherent structures; bursting phenomena; large
scale vortical motions; physical models of coherent structures; numerical
simulations of coherent structures; wave boundary layer.
